stories.headline: Meta stock advances ahead of after-the-bell earnings. What we're looking for
stories.summary: Meta is gaining momentum into earnings as investors await guidance on AI monetization and capex efficiency. Earnings will likely drive near-term tech sector sentiment and validate valuations in the high-multiple AI infrastructure play.
stories.why_matters: Mega-cap tech earnings are crucial barometers for overall equity risk appetite and S&T spending trajectories in the U.S.

stories.headline: Putin agrees to resume 3-way peace talks with Ukraine and US - Reuters
stories.summary: Russia has signaled willingness to resume tripartite negotiations involving Ukraine and the U.S., potentially easing geopolitical tensions. De-escalation rhetoric often supports risk-on sentiment and energy price stability.
stories.why_matters: Geopolitical de-escalation reduces tail risk premiums in equities and commodity markets, benefiting U.S. growth prospects.

stories.headline: OpenAI expands ChatGPT Ads to 26 new countries as diversification push accelerates
stories.summary: OpenAI is broadening its advertising platform globally, signaling monetization ambitions beyond enterprise API sales. Geographic expansion in AI services underscores the strategic shift toward diversified revenue streams.
stories.why_matters: U.S. AI software leadership and revenue diversification bolster confidence in tech sector structural growth and long-term profitability.

concept.title: Risk-On Rotation: Geopolitical Relief Driving Equity Gains
concept.one_liner: De-escalation signals and AI earnings optimism push equities higher while the dollar softens on reduced safe-haven demand.
concept.explanation: The S&P 500's +0.52% gain coupled with EUR/USD strength (+0.0026) and an estimated DXY decline reflects a classic risk-on environment. Easing geopolitical tensions (Putin peace talks) and continued AI platform expansion remove tail risks and support equity valuations. Simultaneously, the weaker dollar signals confidence in growth over safe havens, a hallmark of genuine risk appetite rather than liquidity-driven rallies.
concept.market_link: Today's equity advance and dollar weakness are consistent with a macro backdrop favoring growth assets over defensive positioning.

narrative: The S&P 500 rallies 0.52% on the back of geopolitical de-escalation rhetoric and bullish AI narratives, while EUR/USD strength reflects diminishing dollar-as-safe-haven demand. Market sentiment remains tilted toward equities and growth, though Treasury yield data unavailability limits insight into bond market positioning ahead of Friday's critical PCE print.
